## Project context

- This is a Vite, React 19, and TypeScript static multi-page website for Stutes Clean Water Project Inc.
- Preserve the separate HTML routes at `/work/`, `/stories/`, `/gallery/`, `/about/`, `/team/`, and `/contact/`, with shared React page components.
- Preserve the custom editorial visual direction, light-blue and white palette, and full mobile responsiveness.
- Use only organization-owned project photography sourced directly from its Facebook page. Do not introduce Google-sourced images.
- Keep organization claims, contact details, registration data, and impact figures traceable to verified public information.
- Maintain accessible labels, keyboard behavior, descriptive image alternative text, reduced-motion support, and visible focus states.

## Development guidelines

- Keep the current directory as the project root.
- Preserve existing component and CSS conventions unless a task requires structural changes.
- Use `npm.cmd run lint` for lint validation and `npm.cmd run build` for the production build on Windows.
- Keep SEO metadata and structured data in `index.html` synchronized with visible organization information.
- Keep `README.md` current when setup, content provenance, commands, or deployment behavior changes.
- Follow development best practices and keep communication concise.
